Welcome to the Finology Academy of Mutual Funds!
In this second episode, we are tackling one of the most critical questions every investor asks: who actually holds your money when you invest, how safe is it from scams or fund house failures, and how does Net Asset Value (NAV) really work?
By the end of this episode, you will know exactly where your money resides, how NAV affects your portfolio, and how to read your official Consolidated Account Statement (CAS).
